subject: Emotions
title: The Insula
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Insula usable.

hook.text: Deep inside your brain, a small island of cortex fires every time you feel grossed out.

buildup.text: The insula, Latin for 'island,' processes taste, smell, and internal body signals all at once.

discovery.text: Patients with insula damage lose the ability to feel disgust. They can't recognize it in others either.

twist.text: The insula also drives empathy. The same region that makes you gag helps you feel others' pain.

climax.text: One tiny brain region connects your stomach to your morals to your compassion.

punchline.text: Your disgust center doubles as your empathy center.

quiz.question: What happens when the insula is damaged?
